description.content: Asset Group is classifying assets into specific group based on the different criteria such as integration, asset tag, resource type and resource name.  This helps users to manage, organize, and analyze their assets more efficiently.  User can group assets based on the teams, projects, business units, environments, tech stack etc.
Retrieve a list of asset groups within the tenant. By default, 20 asset groups are returned per request.
